  "memo":"R08 holds because three accounts used the shipping address, but it does not count toward Linkage: this is the current home address, registered long enough to qualify for the household exception. Household sharing best explains the address overlap; coordinated identities remain possible but unsupported. Clear under FP-2 §6.6(c); no verification is required.
